title: feel
category: sub-skill of image-to-react · 60fps scroll, tactile physics & gpu curves
short_summary: verifies 60fps scrolling (eval-feel-and-scroll.py), tactile press response, gpu transform/opacity curves, zero layout shift, and reduced-motion safety.
when_to_use: use in stage 4 of jason-dev-agent to verify 60fps scroll performance and physical feel under pointer, touch, keyboard, and scroll.
summary: Audits, refines, and evaluates how a Golden Template React interface feels under pointer, touch, keyboard, and scroll—covering tactile press response, capability-gated hover, GPU-composited transform and opacity curves, easing and timing discipline, rapid-click interruption, 60fps scroll smoothness, zero layout shift, and reduced-motion safety. Runs a multi-turn dev self-eval loop until every feel gate passes, then hands the same stage back to jason-design-agent via design-critique to judge physical temperament against the original inspiration. Use whenever tuning or grading micro-interactions, motion curves, responsiveness under input, or interface feel. Don't use for adding missing buttons or sliders (use interaction) or static pixel cropping (use replicate-mock).
